input: Learn to knit a simple scarf

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether this is for themselves or as a gift affects the yarn choice, size, and deadline pressure.
Knowing their current skill level determines whether the plan starts with absolute basics (casting on, holding needles) or skips ahead to the knit stitch itself.
A hard deadline (e.g. a holiday gift) dramatically changes how aggressive the learning schedule needs to be.
Whether they already own needles and yarn, or need to buy everything, affects the very first action step.
How much time per week they can dedicate shapes the realistic pace and milestone spacing of the plan.
Their preferred learning format (video, written pattern, in-person class) determines which resources to recommend.
Knowing what a finished scarf means to them — a specific length, stitch pattern, or quality level — defines when the project is truly done.

gold.taskTitle: Learn to knit a simple scarf from scratch
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to knit and complete a simple scarf as their first project.

questions.title: Have you ever knitted or crocheted anything before?
questions.description: Establishes the user's baseline skill level so the plan knows whether to cover holding yarn and needles from scratch or jump straight into the knit stitch.

questions.title: Who is this scarf being made for?
questions.description: Determines whether this is a personal learning project or a gift, which influences yarn colour choices, required dimensions, and emotional stakes.

questions.title: Do you have a target date to finish the scarf?
questions.description: A hard deadline like a birthday or holiday shapes how intensive the learning schedule needs to be.

questions.title: Do you already own knitting needles and yarn?
questions.description: Knowing whether supplies are on hand determines whether the very first step is a shopping trip or casting on.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you practice knitting?
questions.description: Available practice time directly sets the pace of the plan and how far apart milestones should be spaced.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning by video, written instructions, or in-person?
questions.description: Learning format preference determines which tutorials, books, or local classes to recommend as primary resources.

questions.title: What does a finished scarf look like to you — any length, colour, or pattern in mind?
questions.description: Defines the concrete end goal so the plan knows exactly when the project is complete and what quality bar to aim for.
